channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dan Gilbert | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dan Gilbert from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mat Ishbia on Dan Gilbert
item.description:
Suns owner Mat Ishbia:

“I could go talk for hours on it or I could take for a minute and the minute is probably easier: [Dan Gilbert] doesn’t like me and I don’t like him. I don’t like the way they do business in a lot of things. He probably doesn’t like the way we do things. We’re in the same town. We compete. We’re winning. That’s what it is right now. I knew without a question that that’d probably be how he handled [the ownership vote]. And the best part is now you get to see who I see. Very simply. Now you see who I see and what I know about that man.”

Mat Ishbia on Dan Gilbert, May 3, 2023. Source: Spotify.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Dan Gilbert
item.description:
“I think you define culture on how the organization is a class-A organization, and with Dan Gilbert at the helm it's always going to be that way. I think it's about the players you bring in. It's about your coaching staff and who you surround the people with, so, culture is not defined by wins and losses.”

Tyronn Lue on Dan Gilbert, Oct 28, 2018. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Dan Gilbert
item.description:
“(Owner) Dan Gilbert does what it takes to win a championship, try to win a championship. We've done some good things. Just having these guys here who has been through it, been through the tough times, been through the great times as well. This is a bond that can't be broken.”

Tyronn Lue on Dan Gilbert, May 29, 2018. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Raja Bell on Dan Gilbert, Kevin Love
item.description:
Raja Bell:

“There was an element of that when I was in Cleveland. They figured that out, they put it to bed. LeBron went to L.A. had these conversations with Kevin Love, butit was so bad that first year that I was on a phone call with Dan Gilbert and our whole brass and we had a big deal on the table to move Kevin Love in the first year and I was like 'Move him'not because I didn't think he was a good player. I just couldn't see them figuring out how to work as people together.”

Raja Bell on Dan Gilbert, Kevin Love, Jan 26, 2018. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: David Griffin on Dan Gilbert
item.description:
Griffin said Mondayon ESPN's The Jump.

“He went to [Cavs owner] Dan Gilbert privately, told him that he thought he would be happier somewhere else. The absolute worst thing this guy could have done was pretend to be all-in and sink the ship from within. Most guys don't have the courage to do what he did.”

David Griffin on Dan Gilbert, Aug 7, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Dan Gilbert
item.description:
“I have great respect for Dan Gilbert and the Cleveland Cavaliers, and I greatly appreciate the discussions we had regarding their organization,”

Chauncey Billups on Dan Gilbert, Jul 3, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Joe Lacob on Michael Jordan, Dan Gilbert
item.description:
Joe Lacob said, perhaps humble-bragging.

“There were six of us. Actually, Dan was one of them, Dan Gilbert. Anyway, Michael Jordan -- people are drinking and having a good time and all that, but there was a moment where he said, you know, '73 don't mean [blank].'He did it, Michael Jordan did that. And I looked at him and I just decided not to make a big deal of it. I said, you know, you're right, we didn't win it, we had to get better.”

Joe Lacob on Michael Jordan, Dan Gilbert, Feb 7, 2017. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Adam Silver on Dan Gilbert
item.description:
“We know [Cavaliers' owner] Dan Gilbert would very much like it to happen and I think it's just a function of when. Making sure that the timing is right in terms of the upgrades to the building.”

Adam Silver on Dan Gilbert, May 25, 2015. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Alex Jensen on Dan Gilbert
item.description:
“The owner, Dan Gilbert, makes sure you have everything you need. When I was there, they were obviously going through a rebuilding process. But it’s a great practice facility, great people. It’s only a matter of time before they are really good again — year in and year out.”

Alex Jensen on Dan Gilbert, Jan 9, 2014. Source: Salt Lake Tribune.

item.title: Mike Brown on Chris Grant, Dan Gilbert
item.description:
Mike Brown:

“They reached out to me at the end of last week for the first time and after getting over the initial shock of hearing from these guys again I spoke with my wife and thought about all the things that made this job attractive while I was here to begin with. The level of commitment from Dan Gilbert and his group, the thorough work ethic that Chris Grant and his staff display and you look at the roster with the young nucleus and then with Anderson (Varejao) and then the city and passion that the fans have for not only the Cavs but for all their sports teams, for us it was definitely an exciting thing that we were definitely interested in pressing forward with.”

Mike Brown on Chris Grant, Dan Gilbert, Apr 25, 2013. Source: Sports Radio Interviews.

item.title: Adam Silver on Dan Gilbert
item.description:
NBA deputy commissioner Adam Silver said the league would consider returning to Cleveland for the All-Star Game, last held in Northeast Ohio in 1997, when the NBA's 50 greatest players were honored.

“I was in Cleveland last Friday, had extensive discussions with [owner] Dan [Gilbert] and members of his organization and we've encouraged them to bid for a subsequent All-Star Game,”

Adam Silver on Dan Gilbert, Feb 17, 2013. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Byron Scott on Dan Gilbert
item.description:
“It was a little bit of surprise, but (I was) very happy. I think I let you guys know how much I enjoy this organization and the direction we're headed. We have an unbelievable owner in Dan Gilbert, who I have a great relationship with, and a great general manager. We're on the same page as far as how this thing needs to develop. Like I've stated before, I'm extremely happy here in Cleveland.”

Byron Scott on Dan Gilbert, Nov 11, 2012. Source: News-Herald.

item.title: David Stern on Dan Gilbert
item.description:
Sam Amico:David Stern tells reporters on conference call:

“I assure you my decision was reached long before I received (Dan Gilbert's) email.”

David Stern on Dan Gilbert, Dec 14, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: David Stern on Dan Gilbert
item.description:
Gilbert also told The Associated Press that he felt James quit on the Cavs during the playoffs the past two seasons.

“Remarks by Dan Gilbert, the owner of the Cavaliers, catalyzed as they may have been by hurt with respect to the manner and the fact for himself, his team, and particularly for the people of Cleveland, though understandable, were ill advised and imprudent,”

David Stern on Dan Gilbert, Jul 13, 2010. Source: Yahoo! Sports.
